peopleAlsoAsk.question: What are EAR99 materials?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: EAR99 refers to items that are subject to the Export Administration Regulations (EAR) but are not specifically listed on the Commerce Control List (CCL). These items are generally less restricted and do not require an export license unless specific circumstances apply.
